name: Erestor of the Council
oracle_text: Whenever players finish voting, each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for creates a Treasure token. You scry X, where X is the number of opponents who voted for a choice you didn't vote for. Draw a card.
blocked_sentences: Whenever players finish voting, each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for creates a Treasure token. You scry X, where X is the number of opponents who voted for a choice you didn't vote for. Draw a card.

needs.what: a 'players finish voting' trigger event fired after any vote (council's dilemma / will of the council) completes, which binds the vote's record: each player's chosen option(s), so an effect can select 'each opponent who voted for a choice you voted for' (a player filter for for_each_player) and a value can count 'opponents who voted for a choice you didn't vote for' (the scry amount)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has no voting event (nearest are spell_cast/ability_activated, which do not fire on a vote), there is no vote op in reference ops for a vote to come from, and value_keys/player specs have nothing that reads per-player vote choices; for_each_player plus create_token treasure_token and scry/draw cover the effects only once the vote record exists
